cases.question: How fast can a hard money loan close? I need $1.5M for an apartment purchase in three weeks.

expectedFacts.fact: Many close in 10–21 days after a complete file

cases.source: Program primer; Global rule 4, as of 2026-10

cases.question: Who actually funds a private bridge loan that Kubera arranges?

expectedFacts.fact: Private lenders / debt funds fund at closing as lender of record
Kubera is a broker, not the lender

cases.source: Program primer; Global rule 1, as of 2026-10

cases.question: Can Kubera manage my construction draws and hold the funds in escrow for me?

expectedFacts.fact: Kubera does not handle construction draws or hold funds

cases.question: What does a senior living bridge-to-HUD loan typically look like?
My hard money lender charges 12%. Is my loan exempt from California usury limits because Kubera is a broker?

expectedFacts.fact: Depends on lender, collateral and how the loan is arranged
Refers the borrower to their attorney

forbiddenClaims.claim: Says the loan qualifies for, falls under or is covered by the exemption
Says §1916.1 or the broker exemption applies to or exempts the loan
Says the usury cap does not apply to this loan
Says the rate is fine under usury law
Says a specific loan, described by its rate or amount, is exempt

cases.source: Program primer; Civ. Code §1916.1 (gate H), as of 2026-10

expectedFacts.fact: Depends on lender, collateral and how the loan is arranged
